sections.title: Profile
sections.text: A famous action movie star from Yan, FEater was forced to give up her film career after contracting Oripathy. She found a new purpose in life at Rhodes Island.

sections.title: Clinical Analysis
sections.text:
Imaging tests for this Operator showed blurry outlines of internal organs with visible dark spots. Unusually high concentrations of Originium particles were present in her circulatory system, indicating infection and confirming her as Infected at this stage.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 7.2%
Visible traces of Originium on the subject's right leg, but it has not yet crystallized.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] 0.21u/L
FEater's infection is still in early stages and has yet to substantially impact her health.

sections.title: Archive File 1
sections.text: FEater studied martial arts for many years prior to entering the film industry. She is the heir to the Tie Yi Liu He Quan, the Universal Fist of the Iron Will, one of Yan's great martial arts traditions. FEater has mastered all Five Elements, Eight Strikes, and Twelve Forms of her art, giving her the ability to deal devastating blows in the blink of an eye.

sections.title: Archive File 2
sections.text: After contracting Oripathy, FEater's acting career and aspirations came to a screeching halt. But she didn't give into depression like one might expect, since movies to her were just one vehicle for delivering righteousness. The optimistic former star quickly landed back on her feet.

sections.title: Archive File 3
sections.text: Even after becoming a movie star, even having been a legendary martial arts master, FEater has always been someone very approachable. In fact, she is actually rather naive and gets along easily with other Operators. Her hobbies include movies, of course, as well as Yan food, and chugging alcohol with a friendly crowd.
